summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the automatic termination of its Common Shares Purchase Agreement (ELOC) with Five Narrow Lane, L.P. and Hailstone Peak Funding LLC, effective July 24, 2026, due to the company's delisting from Nasdaq. The ELOC allowed Nuvve to sell up to $25 million of common stock at its option. No early termination penalties were incurred. The termination resulted from the delisting, a condition specified in the agreement. Watch for potential financing alternatives or liquidity challenges following the loss of the equity facility.
